client_rule.check: Handrails on GSE being used
client_rule.pass_: Every worker detected on the belt loader has made contact with the handrail while walking. The handrails are extended, providing a safe setup for workers, and no significant obstacles prevent detection.
client_rule.fail: At least one worker on the belt loader has not made contact with the handrail while walking, or handrail usage isn’t consistent across observed frames.

modules.code_review_finding: The blocked-view case is not implemented; the touch check without the pose model credits a touch to every worker seen on the belt loader in the last 2.5 s; the production branch lacks master's `pretrained=False` fix.
